data.navTitle: 橡树干、树篱与阴凉长凳
data.title: A bench under the oak

memoryNodes.cue: Ruth rests a hand on the tree.
Jo steps out of the sun.
The label refers to the local record.

data.situation:
The path levelled out beside an oak. Ruth rested a hand on its trunk while Jo moved into the shade. Hedges separated the shady bench from a small garden. A rare plant grew behind a low rope; Ruth asked them to leave it where it was. Her dog waited by the gate. It belonged to a breed often used for farm work, but today its only job was to stay beside her bag. Jo: Is the plant rare everywhere?
Ruth: It is uncommon here. This label describes our local record.
Maya: Could we sit in the shade for a minute?
Ruth moved her bag so there was room on the bench.

It belonged to a breed often used for farm work, but today its only job was to stay beside her bag.
readingBlocks.zh: 小径在橡树旁变平。露丝把手搭在树干上，乔走到树荫里。树篱把阴凉长凳与小花园分开。一株罕见植物长在低绳后，露丝让她们不要动它。她的狗在门边等候。这是常用于农场工作的一个品种，但今天只需待在包旁。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Is the plant rare everywhere?
Ruth: It is uncommon here. This label describes our local record.
Maya: Could we sit in the shade for a minute?

readingBlocks.zh:
乔：这株植物在哪里都罕见吗？
露丝：在这里不常见。标签说的是本地记录。
玛雅：我们能在树荫里坐一会吗？
露丝挪开包，在长凳上留出位置。

glossary.note: 树干义；象鼻、行李箱未计。
glossary.example: Ruth rested a hand on the oak’s trunk.
glossary.exampleZh: 露丝把手搭在橡树干上。

externalEvidence.definition: the main stem of a tree; usually covered with bark; the bole is usually the part that is commercially useful for lumber

glossary.zh: 由灌木或小树形成的树篱
glossary.note: hedge 单数，hedges 复数；仅计树篱。
glossary.example: Hedges separated the bench from the garden.
glossary.exampleZh: 树篱把长凳与花园分开。

externalEvidence.definition: a fence formed by a row of closely planted shrubs or bushes

glossary.zh: 遮住直射阳光而阴凉的
glossary.note: shady place；可疑、不诚实义未计。
glossary.example: They sat on a shady bench.

glossary.note: in the shade；颜色浓淡与灯罩是其他义。

externalEvidence.definition: relative darkness caused by light rays being intercepted by an opaque body

glossary.example: A rare plant grew behind the rope.
glossary.exampleZh: 绳后长着一株罕见植物。

glossary.zh: 家养动植物的一个品种
glossary.note: 名词a breed；区别于繁殖动词。
glossary.example: Her dog belonged to a breed often used for farm work.
glossary.exampleZh: 她的狗属于常用于农场工作的品种。

externalEvidence.definition: a special variety of domesticated animals within a species
